name: ms-investment-incentives
description: Montserrat tax incentives in force in 2026: the Fiscal Incentives Act, Cap. 15.04 (income tax holidays for approved manufacturing and processing enterprises of up to 15 years for Group I and enclave enterprises, 12 for Group II and 10 for Group III, plus conditional customs relief), the Hotels Aid Act, Cap. 15.16 (duty relief or refund within two years on licensed hotel construction and equipment), the hotel income exemption for five years of assessment in Cap. 17.01 s.10, and relief for registered micro and small businesses under Cap. 15.05 (Form 6, by order, five years of income tax relief unless Cabinet approves longer). Trigger phrases include Montserrat tax holiday, Montserrat fiscal incentives, hotels aid Montserrat, micro and small business relief Montserrat.
